action.command: if command -v rule-engine-init >/dev/null 2>&1; then v=$(rule-engine-init --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -n "$v" ]; then echo "Rule Engine: engine $v"; fi; out=$(rule-engine-init --check 2>&1); rc=$?; if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep '^WARNING'; then :; fi; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo 'Rule Engine: this workspace is missing the always-on rules and/or icon mappings, or they are stale. Before generating any diagram/inventory artifact, bootstrap it: run `bash scripts/bootstrap.sh` from the power skill (it installs or upgrades the engine to the power pin, then copies the steering rules + mappings), and `bash scripts/bootstrap.sh --with-assets` to ALSO download the official GCP/OCI icon packs (only Azure bulk icons are built into draw.io; AWS/GCP/OCI icons are file/stencil assets that are not committed and are embedded as data-URIs, so those diagrams render empty boxes until fetched).'; fi; else echo 'Rule Engine: the rule-engine package is not installed (rule-engine-init is not on PATH), so the lint / icon / raster gates cannot run in this workspace and the save and task hooks skip. Install it before generating diagram or inventory artifacts: the power skill ships scripts/bootstrap.sh, or run `pip install "rule-engine @ git+https://github.com/totoshko88/Cloud_Architecture.git@v1.10.7"` in an active virtualenv.'; fi
